Torre Angela — Rome, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Torre Angela is a large public-housing district near Tor Bella Monaca, and it has a substantial documented history of organised drug trafficking and localized violence. In October 2024 police carried out a major operation dismantling a drug-dealing operation there and arresting members of the Casamonica and Spada clans, well-known Roman crime families. In March 2025, a 21-year-old was stabbed in the stomach during a street brawl involving five people. Local reporting has also covered an illegal toxic-waste dumping operation and repeated complaints that the metro station underpass is unsafe, with residents requesting CCTV. This is one of the most consistently documented problem zones in Municipio VI, warranting a red night rating; daytime activity is calmer but the clan presence and degrado justify some caution.
